issue: The verdict cell prints a numerically false relation and the wrong required throughput: "conditional final — ✗ throughput at a single prefill host (~19.8K ≈ 9.2K); prefill pool must itself scale to ~5 hosts (92K × 19.8K ≈ 4.65), plus a decode pool: 2× capes plus fabric." acceptance_test: The cell must read, verbatim in substance: "✗ throughput at a single prefill host (~19.8K ≪ 92K required); prefill pool must scale to ~5 hosts (92K ÷ 19.8K ≈ 4.65), plus a decode pool: ...". acceptance_test: Replace '×' with '÷' and add the unit to the result: "92K ÷ 19.8K ≈ 4.65 hosts". A reader must be able to reproduce 4.65 from the two printed operands with the printed operator.
